scope: Chamber of Deputies elections of 28–29 May 2010 and 25–26 October 2013 (200 seats each), national level: every list that stood (26 in 2010, 23 in 2013) with its votes and seats, registered voters, issued envelopes, valid votes and published turnout. Regional sums are archived as evidence; candidates and preferential votes are not covered.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner answer 'One-time retrieval exception' for the PS2013/PS2010 CSV packages, only where the national catalogue records no protected rights; no catalogue entry existed, so nothing was retrieved.

Owner brief 'Slovakia and Czechia historical election expansion' naming the PS2013 and PS2010 open-data pages, and answer 'Accept ČSÚ general terms (Recommended)': read the ČSÚ terms by hand and, if they permit reuse with attribution, retrieve the PS2013 and PS2010 CSV packages once each.

reuse_right.basis: ČSÚ terms (read 2026-11-21, quoted in evidence): statistical information published through csu.gov.cz is licensed CC BY 4.0. The sentence names csu.gov.cz; the volby.gov.cz pages link these terms in their footer, and the owner accepted them as the basis for the volby.gov.cz files. Attribution: Český statistický úřad.

normalized_republication.basis: National votes and seats per list and national turnout figures, with attribution and a link to the terms; region × list sums archived as evidence; no candidate field.

raw_redistribution.basis: The CSV packages are not redistributed. Committed: per-region sums of the district tables, the list register (list fields only), code-list rows used by a list and per-list elected counts.

acquisition_route.basis: Six named CSV packages on volby.gov.cz (data, registers and code lists for 2010 and 2013) retrieved once each, 5 seconds apart, identifying User-Agent; robots.txt disallows /pls/ only. ČSÚ terms page read once. Statutes, election calls and the 2013 results notice read in a browser on e-Sbírka.

source_files_complete.basis: All polling districts (14,894 in 2010, 14,873 in 2013, matching VOLPS03), the full list register, and the code-list rows of every list.

national_definition_complete.basis: build-ps2010-2013: district sums equal ČSÚ VOLPS03 registered voters, issued envelopes, valid votes and district counts and reproduce the published turnout (62.6%, 59.48%); list votes equal valid votes in every region; register seats equal the elected count per list; §§ 48–50 re-run on the regional votes reproduce every list's seats; 2013: all 360 cells of notice 343/2013 Sb. equal the district sums.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Each list that stood is one contestant (list register KSTRANA). All were single parties or movements (code-list type S, one proposer). Lists that recorded no vote in any district (2010 list 3, 2013 list 19; absent from notice 343/2013 Sb.) are not contestants. No link to any other election.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: Act 247/1995 Coll., e-Sbírka versions 14 Sep 2009 – 15 Jun 2010 and 26 Jun 2012 – 6 Apr 2014: § 24 (200 seats), § 27 (districts abroad assigned by lot), § 48 (republic mandate number), § 49 (5/10/15/20% thresholds), § 50 (successive divisors within each region). §§ 48–51 read identically in both versions.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: ČSÚ data packages dated 2023-02-24 and registers 2023-04-28. Polling days from the presidential decisions 37/2010 Sb. and 266/2013 Sb. The 2010 results notice was not located; the 2013 notice 343/2013 Sb. equals the data.

continuity: None: the identity layer covers 2017 onward; 2010 and 2013 lists carry their own register codes but are not linked to any other election.
